town_square_01.name: Oakvale's Town Square
town_square_01.description: The town square of the small but busy town of Oakvale. Merchants, farmers, and travellers pass through here throughout the day.
town_square_01.minorDescription: an open area with a small stone well in the middle.

main_street_01.name: Oakvale's Main Street
main_street_01.description: A broad street running through the northern half of Oakvale. Small businesses and houses line both sides of the road.
main_street_01.minorDescription: a busy street lined with wooden buildings.

commercial_district_01.name: Oakvale's Commercial District
commercial_district_01.description: A crowded collection of shops, stalls, workshops, and warehouses. The smell of cooked food mixes with the smoke of nearby forges.
commercial_district_01.minorDescription: a crowded street filled with shops and market stalls.

residential_area_01.name: Oakvale's Residential District
residential_area_01.description: A quieter part of town filled with modest houses, gardens, washing lines, and the occasional barking dog.
residential_area_01.minorDescription: a quiet neighborhood of small houses and gardens.

town_gate_01.name: Oakvale's South Gate
town_gate_01.description: A sturdy wooden gate marking the southern entrance to Oakvale. Beyond it, a dirt road stretches into the countryside.
town_gate_01.minorDescription: a large wooden gate leading out into the countryside.

chapel_01.name: Oakvale Chapel
chapel_01.description: A small stone chapel with wooden benches and simple decorations. It is noticeably quieter than the rest of town.
chapel_01.minorDescription: a small stone building with a wooden door and a quiet interior.

old_mill_01.name: Old Mill
old_mill_01.description: An aging wooden mill stands beside a narrow stream. The machinery still works, although every part of it makes a different unpleasant noise.
old_mill_01.minorDescription: an old wooden mill beside a shallow stream.

sewer_entrance_01.name: Oakvale Sewer Entrance
sewer_entrance_01.description: A damp stone passage beneath the town. The air is cold and unpleasant, and the sound of running water echoes through the tunnels.
sewer_entrance_01.minorDescription: a dark stone passage descending beneath the town.

sewer_tunnel_01.name: Oakvale Sewer Tunnels
sewer_tunnel_01.description: A maze of narrow stone tunnels beneath Oakvale. Water trickles through channels along the walls, and something occasionally moves in the darkness.
sewer_tunnel_01.minorDescription: a dark tunnel disappearing beneath the town.

north_road_01.name: Northern Road
north_road_01.description: A dirt road leading away from Oakvale toward the hills. The town walls quickly disappear behind you as the road winds through open countryside.
north_road_01.minorDescription: a dirt road leading toward distant hills.

south_road_01.name: Southern Road
south_road_01.description: A well-worn road extending south from Oakvale. Wagon tracks and footprints suggest that travellers frequently use this route.
south_road_01.minorDescription: a dirt road stretching south beyond the town gate.

warehouse_lane_01.name: Warehouse Lane
warehouse_lane_01.description: A narrow lane behind Oakvale's shops. Several old warehouses stand along the road, their wooden doors reinforced with iron bands.
warehouse_lane_01.minorDescription: a narrow lane lined with large wooden warehouses.
